fields.label: Driver Name
fields.description: What this cost is called (e.g. Die/Frame, Cutting, Glue - 1 Side, Printing, Packing, Artwork).

fields.label: Calculation Role
fields.options:
Printing
Cutting
Die
Glue
Lamination
Packing
fields.description: Technical behavior used by the estimate engine. Templates still decide whether this cost item belongs to a product; this role only tells the engine how a selected row should calculate and which simple form control it follows. Leave blank for ordinary costs such as Artwork, Plate, or Rolling.

fields.label: Measurement Basis
fields.options:
Per cm2
Per 1000 Sheets
Per 1000 Pieces
Per Sheet
Per Sheet (Declining Rate)
Per Carton
Per Side
Per Colour
Flat Fee
Per Hour
fields.description: What this cost scales with. 'Per 1000 Sheets' and 'Per 1000 Pieces' are deliberately separate - printing scales with physical sheets run through the press, while cutting/glue often scale with finished pieces instead. 'Per Sheet (Declining Rate)' is for a per-sheet cost that gets cheaper continuously as volume grows, down to a floor rate - not discrete tiers like Cutting/Printing, a straight-line interpolation between a confirmed starting rate and a confirmed floor rate (e.g. Lamination: 0.80 SAR/sheet at 1,000 sheets, sliding down to a 0.55 SAR/sheet floor at 150,000 sheets - Mofeed's real numbers, only 2 confirmed points, so linear is the model with the least invented assumption). 'Per Carton' is for Packing: cost = Rate x cartons, where cartons is computed from Sheets Required, the Sheet Size's A4-Equivalent Count, the paper's GSM, and Print Suite Settings' Sheets per Carton - Mofeed's real packing formula, not a flat guess. 'Per Hour' is included even though nothing uses it yet - a hedge so machine-time-based costing (what larger print MIS platforms use) is a natural extension later, not a rebuild.

fields.label: Fixed Setup Cost
fields.description: A flat cost added on top of the volume-based rate, regardless of quantity - e.g. Golden Arrow's real Printing cost is a 100 SAR setup fee PLUS the tiered per-1000-sheet rate, not the tiered rate alone. Leave at 0 if this driver has no fixed component.

fields.label: Rate Varies by Quantity (Tiered)
fields.description: Check this if the rate itself gets cheaper at higher volumes (common for Printing, Cutting, Glue). If checked, fill in the Tiers table below instead of a single Rate.

fields.label: Rate (if not tiered)
fields.description: Used only when 'Rate Varies by Quantity' is unchecked - a single flat rate per unit of the Measurement Basis (e.g. 37.5 SAR per colour for Plate, or 0.15 SAR per cm² for Die).

fields.label: Tiers (only used if 'Rate Varies by Quantity' is checked)
Declining Rate (only used for 'Per Sheet (Declining Rate)')
Rate Applies At/Below This Sheet Qty
fields.description: The sheet quantity the Starting Rate below is confirmed at (e.g. 1,000). At or below this quantity, the Starting Rate is used exactly - no interpolation.

fields.label: Starting Rate (SAR/sheet)
fields.description: The confirmed per-sheet rate at the low-volume point above (e.g. 0.80 SAR/sheet at 1,000 sheets).

fields.label: Floor Applies At/Above This Sheet Qty
fields.description: The sheet quantity the Floor Rate below is confirmed at, and beyond (e.g. 150,000). At or above this quantity, the Floor Rate is used exactly - the rate never drops further.

fields.label: Floor Rate (SAR/sheet)
fields.description: The confirmed minimum per-sheet rate at the high-volume point above (e.g. 0.55 SAR/sheet at 150,000 sheets - Golden Arrow's real floor, never goes lower no matter how large the job).

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Where this rate came from and how confident we are in it - e.g. 'Confirmed directly by Mofeed, Golden Arrow's estimator, 2026-07-26' vs 'Estimated, pending confirmation'.
